message.zh: 26.4.14 是重要更新：任务筛选新增长按锁定与刷新卡片保留，任务刷新后的类型、锁定状态和图片会即时同步；同时修复生产、购物清单、资产与公会统计等问题，并加入公会神龛着装评分。建议前往 Greasy Fork 更新。
message.en: Version 26.4.14 is an important update. Task filters add long-press locks and rerolled-card retention, with task types, lock state, and artwork synchronizing immediately after rerolls. It also fixes Production, the shopping list, Asset and Guild statistics, and adds guild-shrine Gear Scores. Update on Greasy Fork.
